camel_example: aliyun ims GetGovernanceItemReport --region cn-hangzhou --GovernanceItemType SSOLoginEnabled --Marker EXAMPLE --MaxItems 1000
description_en: Queries the details of a specific check item in an identity and access governance report
description_zh: 查询身份权限治理检测报告中指定治理检测项的信息
kebab_example: aliyun ims get-governance-item-report --governance-item-type SSOLoginEnabled --marker EXAMPLE --max-items 1000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetGovernanceItemReport

parameters.help_en: The check item. For more information, see Identity and access governance check items (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ram/user-guide/overview-of-cloud-governance-for-ram?spm=a2c4g.11174283.0.0.88b3de53tfL5XG#section-q06-p9p-8vl)
parameters.help_zh: 治理检测项，取值可参考文档：身份权限治理检测项 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ram/user-guide/overview-of-cloud-governance-for-ram?spm=a2c4g.11174283.0.0.88b3de53tfL5XG#section-q06-p9p-8vl)
parameters.name: governance_item_type

parameters.help_en: If the response is truncated, use the `Marker` to retrieve the subsequent content
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`Marker`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return. If the response is truncated because the number of entries exceeds the value of `MaxItems`, the value of the `IsTruncated` parameter is true.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于true。

取值范围：1~1000。默认值：1000
parameters.name: max_items

ColumnSchema.description_en: The schema of the detail columns. This is an array, and its length is the number of columns
ColumnSchema.description_zh: 明细的列模式，数组，长度为明细列数

items.description_en: The schema of a single detail column

ColumnType.description_en:
The column type. Valid values:

Number: the numeric type.

String: the string type.

Boolean: the Boolean type
ColumnType.description_zh:
列类型，取值：
Number：数值类型。
String：字符串类型。
Boolean：布尔类型

ColumnRow.description_en: The detailed values, which are a two-dimensional array. Each row has a fixed length. The data type, value, length, and order of values in each row are consistent with the schema described in ColumnsSchema
ColumnRow.description_zh: 明细值，二维数组。每一行都是定长，每一行中，每一个值的类型、取值，这一行的长度和取值顺序都和ColumnsSchema中描述的保持一致

items.description_en: The data object in this row

GenerateTime.description_en: The time when the report for the check item was generated
GenerateTime.description_zh: 身份权限治理报告该治理检测项的生成时间

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the response is truncated. Valid values:

true

false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
请求返回结果是否被截断。取值：
true
false

Marker.description_en: This parameter is returned only when `IsTruncated` is set to true. Use this parameter to retrieve the truncated content
Marker.description_zh: 此参数在`IsTruncated`为true时生效，用于获取截断后的内容

MetricType.description_en:
The data type of the metric value. Valid values:

Number: the numeric type.

String: the string type.

Boolean: the Boolean type
MetricType.description_zh:
指标值类型，取值：
Number：数值类型。
String：字符串类型。
Boolean：布尔类型
